title: A Group Chat for the Locker
author: Ansel Vane
blurb: Ulyana Reyes, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must save the tradition that made the town before prom.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
